name: radial-gallery
title: Radial Gallery
description: Circular rotating image gallery. Items are evenly spaced around a ring that spins continuously. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

usage.label: Astro
usage.code:
---
import "@/components/motion-kit/radial-gallery-element.ts";
---

<motion-radial-gallery
  items='[{"src":"/img/1.jpg"},{"src":"/img/2.jpg"}]'
  radius="480"
  duration="24"
  element-size="160"
  class="h-[360px] w-full overflow-hidden"
></motion-radial-gallery>

usage.label: React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-kit/radial-gallery-element.ts";
</script>

<template>
  <motion-radial-gallery
    :items='JSON.stringify([{"src":"/img/1.jpg"},{"src":"/img/2.jpg"}])'
    radius="480"
    duration="24"
    element-size="160"
    class="h-[360px] w-full overflow-hidden"
  />
</template>

usage.code:

<motion-radial-gallery

props.name: items
props.description: JSON array of image objects with src and alt properties.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the circle in pixels.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of one full rotation in seconds.

props.name: offset
props.description: Extra pixels to offset the ring center below the visible area.

props.name: element-size
props.description: Estimated item width in pixels for circumference calculations.
